title: HARD ENEMIES DROP BETTER LOOT
why: His order (2026-10-15): "Hard enemies drop better loot." An elite of any kind, a sentry, a bulwark or a howler now always leaves its wreck or body and adds one roll on a better table (cache for an elite, safe for a hard machine), never a gun. Rolled at the death, so the seeded build is unchanged.
now: Elite pillagers and machines, sentries, bulwarks and howlers now drop better loot, and always leave a wreck.
